adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB write happens first via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, then `attendeesList` is built with `Promise.all(attendeesListPromises)` where each promise awaits `getTranslation(...)`. That `Promise.all` is not wrapped in a try/catch, so any single translation load rejection will throw and abort the handler after guests have already been persisted, and before `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(...)` and `sendAddGuestsEmails(...)` run. This can leave the system in a partially-updated state (guests stored but no calendar/email updates).
